values.note: Daily, electric included, two guests: summer (Apr 1 - Sep 30) standard $45, premium $55, premium pond $60; winter (Oct 1 - Mar 31) standard $55, premium $65, pond $70. Extra guest $10 a night. Tent sites $35/$45. The rate table carries no year (read 2026-10-16 and 2026-10-21).

note: Family-owned 49-acre all-ages RV park 2 mi from Weeki Wachee Springs; nightly transient + seasonal/monthly; RV and tent sites, some without sewer (one honey-wagon pump-out a week included); on-site catch-and-release catfish pond with canoes/kayaks, clubhouse. --Claude
